meta.title: Prompt Forge
meta.description: One Prompt button beside the composer: its panel rewrites the draft into an executable prompt by a prompt-engineering doctrine (length scales with the task), or lists only the unknowns you have not considered. Answers come back as pickable rows, so you decide what replaces or extends the draft. The rules live in an editable file, and the same rewrite is exposed to agents as a tool.
